name: Elevate Metrics Popup Builder
author: kamalkashyapp

sections.description:
Elevate Metrics Popup Builder is a lightweight promotional modal and marketing popup builder designed to display festival banners, discount offers, and coupon codes without slowing down your site.

Built with clean HTML5 and vanilla JavaScript, it provides essential popup capabilities without requiring bulky third-party libraries or monthly subscriptions.

Key Features

  • Lightweight Architecture: Pure HTML5 and vanilla JavaScript with zero frontend jQuery dependencies.
  • Responsive Layout: Adapts smoothly across mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.
  • 1-Click Coupon Code Copy: Shoppers can copy discount coupon codes with a single tap, with instant visual feedback.
  • Native Media Library: Select promotional banners and posters directly through the standard WordPress media uploader.
  • Device Targeting: Choose to display on All Devices, Mobile Only, or Desktop Only.
  • Custom Delay & Cooldown Intervals: Configure display delay in seconds and frequency cooldown in hours via browser localStorage so returning visitors are not repeatedly prompted.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the elevate-metrics-popup-builder folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the .zip archive via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Elevate Popup in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Upload your promotional banner, enter your target link and coupon code, then click Save Popup Settings.
sections.faq:
Does Elevate Metrics Popup Builder load external scripts?

No. All scripts and styles are local, lightweight, and execute without third-party tracking or bloated external libraries.

Can I use this on WooCommerce stores?

Yes. It works with WooCommerce, classic themes, and block themes.

Can I update my banners and coupon codes anytime?

Yes. You can update images, target links, coupon codes, and cooldown timings anytime from the plugin settings page.
